title: Lior and the Gravity
author: Oscar Coldharbour
blurb: Kestrel Okafor, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
